disposition: bracket-mounted connector with a 12 cm two-conductor shielded cable; no X6 body or pin footprint exists on the PCB

factory_wire_table.interpretation: The table proves A:3 and A:4 terminate at bracket X6. Independent system drawing ДГШ3.031.011 Э6 identifies X6 as the two-conductor display cable; exact .009 Э3 sheet 2 labels output contact 3 VIDEO and contact 4 ground. The July component photo places A:3 beside VT2/R65, not at VD3; its exact target-board copper continuation remains unresolved. A:4 appears on a separate wide ground strip.

component_observations.observation: The A:3 braided-cable joint is beside VT2/R65. The distinct glass VD3 body is about 400 original pixels to the right, so the former claim that this joint coincides with VD3.2 is rejected. A:4 terminates on a separate wide strip. Corrected D102-local pixel-to-board affine replaces the former 19 mm displaced board coordinates.
The May oblique view confirms separated A:3/A:4 cable conductors and shows VD3 apart from the A:3 joint; it does not prove A:3 electrical net.

solder_observations.observation: The projected regions are crowded solder-side package/copper fields and do not identify dedicated cable holes. This agrees with the direct component-side lap-solder construction; the solder projection is retained as a non-promotion check.

A:3.documented_role: display video conductor; copper join to VT2.1/R65.1 pending continuity

promotion_basis: Factory assembly table and independent system cable map establish X6 as the display cable, with A:3 documented as video conductor and A:4 as return. The A:3 joint-to-VT2/R65 electrical continuity remains unmeasured; earlier VD3.2/SOUND_CLAMP promotion is retracted. Corrected board coordinates are (280.233,123.791) for A:3 and (285.606,122.617) for A:4 from the D102-local affine in c94-endpoint-registration.json.
review_status: A:3-to-VD3.2/SOUND_CLAMP promotion retracted by original-resolution component-photo reread; see docs/x6-a3-video-source-conflict-review.md
